_why: S15 Cyber Bunny: SB CH_P_EVE_47_BB has Use_ML_Stocking on, but its stocking mask is bound as 'MaskTexture' = CH_P_EVE_47_BB_STKMask, not 'MASK_Stocking' -> make_eve_auto.mat_spec() found no mask and built bare skin; only the diamond net lines baked in CH_P_EVE_47_BB_A remained ('net lines on bare legs'). Now the mask is used: thin dark sheer base (tint 393431 family, 40 % skin through, skin shading and the baked net lines kept), net size / UVs untouched. Mask channel: CH_P_EVE_47_BB_STKMask R is 1.0 everywhere (first try darkened chest and arms), G/B = 59 % = the legs -> G.
